identity.name: Harry Potter
identity.description: A brave and determined young wizard known for his loyalty, courage, compassion, resilience, and willingness to stand against injustice.
identity.background: Harry Potter is a wizard who grew up unaware of his magical heritage before discovering that he was famous in the wizarding world. He later attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where he formed strong friendships, faced dangerous threats, and repeatedly stood against Voldemort and his followers.
